To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel series of 1-(6-substituted-1,3-benzothiazol-2-yl)-3-(substituted pheny)hexahydro-2,4, 6-pyrimidinetrione 4a-t were synthesized and evaluated for their antiepileptic activity.
1,3‐substituted hexahydro‐2‐,4,6 pyrimidinetrione derivatives containing a 6‐substitued benzothiazole moiety were found to be promising anticonvulants with a wide safety profile.
the compounds 4c and 4s were found to possess promising anticonvulsive activity in both the MES and scPTZ tests.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, synthesis, and biological evaluation of a series of novel benzothiazole incorporated barbituric acids as anticonvulsants.
the design and synthesis of new anticonvulsants containing benzothiazole moiety.
the synthesis and anticonvulsants screening of benzothiazole incorporated barbituric derivatives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the incorporation of the benzothiazole moiety into the barbituric ring system has led to the synthesis of a novel class of anticonvulsants with promising anticonvulsive activities.
the incorporation of benzothiazole ring in the barbituric moiety of the compounds has improved the pharmacological profile.
the incorporation of benzothiazole moiety into barbituric acids resulted in the generation of a new series of anticonvulsants.

the compounds 4c (IC50 = 1.2 mg/kg), 4d (IC50 =2.2 mg/kg) and 4s (IC50 =0.9 mg/kg) could be potential antiepileptic drug candidates.

the combination of benzothiazole moiety with barbituric acids is a good approach for the design of anticonvulsants.
